country.name: Algeria
country.jurisdictionNotice: Algeria is a unitary state. National ministries govern the principal education frameworks while wilaya education directorates and institutions perform assigned implementation and administration.
country.languagePolicy: Arabic and Tamazight are official languages. French and English have curriculum roles but must not be presented as constitutionally equivalent language categories. Interface translation is not a substitute for reviewed curriculum localization or community-specific Tamazight language work.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Algerian reviewer, current authoritative evidence and review by the responsible ministry, wilaya directorate, institution, program authority, privacy authority or child-protection authority.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry of National Education controls national school policy and programs; wilaya directorates administer territorial implementation and statistics. Higher education is governed separately by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research.
governanceModel.nationalAuthority: Ministry of National Education and Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research within their respective competences
governanceModel.territorialAuthority: Wilaya education directorates within their assigned competence
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve the official institution name, wilaya, commune, sector, level, legal status, operational status, source date and review date. National aggregate counts and wilaya administrative responsibility are not a public school directory.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution creation or legal status, authorization, authorization of a private institution, habilitation of an exact training offer, degree-awarding authority, site, modality, professional recognition and quality or accreditation decisions are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of National Education
authorities.role: national school policy, programs, official texts and system administration

authorities.name: Wilaya education directorates
authorities.role: territorial school administration and collection and analysis of school statistics

authorities.name: National Institute for Educational Research and curriculum bodies
authorities.role: research, curriculum and pedagogical resources within their mandates

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
authorities.role: higher-education system, university network and private-establishment authorization

authorities.name: National Authority for Personal Data Protection
authorities.role: personal-data protection authority under Law 18-07 as amended

authorities.name: National Body for the Protection and Promotion of Childhood
authorities.role: child-protection authority and official child-protection legislation source

curriculum.title: Algerian national education programs and official pedagogical texts
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm level, year, subject, language, official program or bulletin text, version, publication date, entry-into-force school year, transitional schedule and institution context. The July 2026 announcement places English from third primary and French from fourth primary beginning in 2026–2027; it must not be retroactively applied to earlier cohorts or silently generalized beyond its stated phase.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Framework law, official program, accompanying document, annual ministry arrangement, future reform, pilot and external resource are different layers. A planned or phased change must not be presented as already effective for every learner.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of National Education and wilaya education directorates
schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: Official ministry and wilaya institution records
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: No current consolidated public national school-level directory was verified during this review. Ministry aggregate institution counts and the mission of wilaya directorates do not identify individual schools. BRASA must not fabricate school records or convert an aggregate into a directory; each institution requires an official wilaya or institution record and current-status verification.

educationStatistics.authority: Ministry of National Education and wilaya education directorates
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The ministry homepage labels its displayed system snapshot as school year 2024–2025, while later ministry releases publish other dated figures. Every number must preserve observation or school year, publication date, measure definition, population, level, public or private sector, geography and source. Figures from different vintages must not be merged into a false current total.

higherEducation.recognitionAuthority: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and other competent authorities for the exact qualification
higherEducation.authorityNotice: The official university network and an authorization to create or operate a private higher-education institution do not prove that every training offer, diploma, campus or modality is authorized. Institution status, private-establishment authorization number and date, habilitation of the exact training offer, degree-awarding authority, site, modality, validity, professional recognition and any quality or accreditation decision must be verified separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 18-07 of 10 June 2018, amended and supplemented by Law No. 25-11 of 24 July 2025
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: National Authority for Personal Data Protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Law No. 15-12 of 15 July 2015 on child protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Learner identity, consent or other lawful basis, controller responsibility, minimization, security, retention, rights, sensitive and biometric data, cross-border processing, child protection, reporting, image use and institutional authorization require qualified review under the current amended law and implementing rules before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Arabic and Tamazight are official languages; French and English have distinct foreign-language curriculum roles and phased grade arrangements. Tamazight language varieties, orthographies and community contexts must not be treated as interchangeable. Preserve the learner's language, exact program, grade, effective school year and qualified local review.

completionCriteria: A qualified Algerian education reviewer is named.
National ministry, wilaya, institution and program responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified school-directory source is documented or the directory gap remains visibly disclosed.
Every school record has official evidence, status, location, source date and review date.
Every statistic preserves school year, publication date, definition, population, level, sector and geography.
Curriculum mappings preserve official text, version, level, subject, language and phased effective school year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution authorization, exact program habilitation, degree authority, site, modality and validity.
Arabic, Tamazight, French and English are represented according to their distinct legal and curricular roles.
Privacy, child-protection, accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline and incident procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
